name: International Labour Organization
body: security.txt is published, HSTS covers subdomains, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But no page analyzed carries JSON-LD, so the Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube profiles it links are never tied to the ILO.
lesson: Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.
summary: www.ilo.org scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 17 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: 14 pages have no meta description.

fix.title: 14 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /about-ilo, /topics-and-sectors, /regions-and-countries, /research-and-publications and 10 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Positive tabindex reorders the keyboard path
fix.fix: Use tabindex="0" or the natural order.

fix.title: 17 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 6 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 24 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 465 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
